tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) THEN json_object('candidate_name',c.name,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.stage_extension,a.stage),'scheduled_at',i.scheduled_at,'duration_minutes',i.duration_minutes,'location',i.location,'format',i.format,'status',i.status,'email',c.email,'phone',c.phone,'profile_url',COALESCE((SELECT profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources WHERE application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')),'source',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT source FROM hiring_application_sources WHERE application_id=a.id),a.source) END,'source_detail',a.source_detail,'basis_reference',a.basis_reference,'contact_context',a.contact_context,'notes',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('body',body,'actor_user_id',actor_user_id,'created_at',created_at)) FROM hiring_notes WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'attachments',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'filename',filename,'mime_type',mime_type,'size_bytes',size_bytes,'scan_state',scan_state)) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id AND deleted_at IS NULL)),'worker_communications',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body,'direction',direction)) FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'communications',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body,'direction',direction)) FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'drafts',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body)) FROM hiring_outbox WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id))) ELSE json_object('candidate_name',c.name,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.stage_extension,a.stage),'scheduled_at',i.scheduled_at,'duration_minutes',i.duration_minutes,'location',i.location,'format',i.format,'status',i.status) END AS packet_json FROM interviews i JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=i.application_id AND a.organization_id=i.tenant_id AND a.brand_id=i.brand_id AND a.requisition_id=i.requisition_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE i.id=:interview_id AND i.application_id=:application_id AND i.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND i.brand_id=:brand_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p JOIN interview_assignments ia ON ia.interview_id=i.id AND ia.reviewer_id=p.user_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE p.organization_id=i.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=i.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='reviewer' AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=i.requisition_id)) AND i.status='scheduled')) LIMIT 1

tools.sql: SELECT s.assignment_id,s.version,s.status,s.criteria_json,s.created_at,s.submitted_at FROM hiring_scorecard_versions s JOIN interview_assignments a ON a.id=s.assignment_id JOIN interviews i ON i.id=a.interview_id WHERE a.id=:assignment_id AND a.interview_id=:interview_id AND a.application_id=:application_id AND a.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.status='scheduled' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications app WHERE app.id=a.application_id AND app.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND app.brand_id=a.brand_id AND app.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND s.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND s.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.application_id=:application_id AND s.interview_id=:interview_id AND s.version<COALESCE(:before_version,2147483647) ORDER BY s.version DESC LIMIT 50

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_scorecard_versions(id,assignment_id,interview_id,application_id,tenant_id,brand_id,requisition_id,reviewer_id,version,status,criteria_json,created_at,submitted_at,operation_id) SELECT :__uuid,a.id,a.interview_id,a.application_id,a.tenant_id,a.brand_id,a.requisition_id,:__user_id,:expected_version+1,:status,:criteria_json,:__now,CASE WHEN :status='submitted' THEN :__now END,:operation_id FROM interview_assignments a JOIN interviews i ON i.id=a.interview_id WHERE a.id=:assignment_id AND a.interview_id=:interview_id AND a.application_id=:application_id AND a.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.status='scheduled' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications app WHERE app.id=a.application_id AND app.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND app.brand_id=a.brand_id AND app.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :expected_version=COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE assignment_id=a.id),0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE assignment_id=a.id AND status='submitted') AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)
